options.name: ca_bundle
options.description: Path of a CA bundle used to validate the Horizon instance SSL certificate.

options.name: campaign
options.description: The name of the discovery campaign to feed into.

options.name: certificate_pem
options.description: The PEM-encoded certificate to feed the discovery campaign with.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: Path of a client certificate. Required if you use certificate based authentication

options.name: client_key
options.description: Path to the private key used for client-certificate authentication. Required if you use certificate based authentication. Restrict access to the key and inventory configuration files.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the controller to establish a connection to Horizon.

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Your Horizon instance base endpoint. It must include the protocol (https://) and no trailing slash nor path.

options.name: paths
options.description: The path to the certificate on the host machine.

options.name: read_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait between response reads by the controller after connecting to Horizon.

options.name: usages
options.description: The path of the configuration files that were used to find the certificates.

options.name: x_api_id
options.description: Horizon identifier Required if you use credentials authentication

options.name: x_api_key
options.description: Secret API key used for Horizon credential authentication. Required if you use credentials authentication. Store this value with Ansible Vault. Tasks containing lookup expressions with this value should use C(no_log=true).
